name.ja: 1/1000 地球連邦アンドロメダ級三番艦アポロノーム
name.en: 1/1000 Earth Federation Andromeda class third ship Apollo Nome

description.ja: 宇宙戦艦ヤマト2202 地球連邦 アンドロメダ級三番艦 アポロノームが1/1000スケールで登場！
description.en: Space Battleship Yamato 2202 Earth Federation Andromeda class third ship Apollo Nome is now available in 1/1000 Scale!

description.ja: • 三番艦「アポロノーム」の最大の特徴である発着区画を新規造形で再現！1/1000ならではのディテールで細部まで徹底造形！
description.en: • The biggest feature of the third ship "Apollo Nome" is the take-off and landing section, reproduced with new modeling! Thorough modeling with details unique to 1/1000!

description.ja: • 発着区画上部から見える地球連邦軍のマークは水転写式デカールで再現が可能！
description.en: • The Earth Federation army mark visible from the top of the landing area can be reproduced with water transfer decals!

description.ja: • 艦載機は同スケールの「コスモファルコン」が新規造形で2機付属！ディスプレイベースで展示することが可能。
description.en: • Two new "Cosmo Falcons" of the same scale are included as carrier-based aircraft! Can be displayed on a display base.

description.ja: • 発売中の一番艦 アンドロメダ、二番艦 アルデバランと並べてディスプレイすることで劇中の名シーンを迫力の艦隊編成で再現可能に！
description.en: • By displaying them alongside the first ship Andromeda and the second ship Aldebaran, which are currently being released, you can recreate famous scenes from the play with an impressive fleet formation!

accessories.ja: 艦載機コスモファルコン×2
艦載機コスモタイガーII×4
accessories.en: Carrier-based aircraft Cosmo Tiger II x 4
